name: @local/dsh-ac-boot
description: A holographic mission-briefing opening sequence for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. v0.15.0 rebuilds the theater as an in-world tactical interface: procedural coastlines, a latitude/longitude graticule, satellite data rails on both edges, dense layered data-node bursts (fine / mid / long rays plus cardinal spikes from each bright core), a magenta highlighted sector, city tags and a mission subtitle line. The map is drawn entirely in SVG; Agnes supplies only the terrain relief and holographic table textures. Host contract unchanged (name + inject=['webServer'], splash rows only, read-only /acb/assets). Launch-scoped one-shot behaviour preserved.
